description: Landing page loads at the root path and returns HTTP 200
steps: Navigate to https://flip7.michaelharjani.com/
Verify HTTP status is 200
Verify page title contains 'Flip7'

description: Landing page hero section displays game branding and play options
steps: Navigate to /
Take screenshot of hero section
Verify hero contains game title, tagline, and at least two play option buttons
Verify layout is centered and uses DaisyUI dark theme by default

description: Google OAuth sign-in button is present and routes to the OmniAuth entry
steps: Navigate to /
Locate the 'Sign in with Google' button
Click it and verify the browser navigates to /users/auth/google_oauth2

description: Full Google OAuth round trip creates a user record from the omniauth payload
steps: Navigate to /
Click 'Sign in with Google'
Complete the Google OAuth consent screen for a test account
Verify the browser is redirected to /users/auth/google_oauth2/callback
Verify the callback redirects to / or /profile when successful
Query the users table and verify a row exists with the test account's provider='google_oauth2' and uid
Verify the user's email, name, and avatar_url were populated from auth.info
Verify elo_rating defaults to 1000
Verify games_played defaults to 0
Verify the session cookie is set and the user appears logged in
Reload the landing page and verify the nav shows the user's name

description: Sign out clears the session and returns the user to the landing page
steps: Sign in as a test user
Click the sign out link in the nav
Verify redirect to /
Verify the nav no longer shows the user's name

description: Guest users can access solo mode without logging in
steps: Navigate to / without logging in
Click 'Play Solo'
Verify /play/solo loads and is usable
Verify no redirect to a login page

description: Guest users are blocked from casual multiplayer and ranked
steps: Navigate to /play/casual as a guest
Verify the page prompts for Google sign-in or redirects
Navigate to /play/ranked as a guest
Verify the page blocks access and prompts for sign-in

description: Guest solo sessions display a persistent 'Sign in to save progress' prompt
steps: Start a solo game as a guest
Take a screenshot of the game view
Verify a visible banner or toast reads 'Sign in to save progress' and is not dismissible

description: Logged-in nav exposes profile, friends, stats, and leaderboard links
steps: Sign in as a test user
Open the primary nav
Verify links exist for /profile, /friends, /stats, and /leaderboard

description: Custom domain serves HTTPS with Railway-managed SSL certificate
steps: Open https://flip7.michaelharjani.com
Verify the certificate is valid and issued to the domain
Verify requesting the http:// version redirects to https://

description: Solo setup page lets the user configure between 1 and 9 bots for a single-deck game
steps: Navigate to /play/solo
Set bot count to 3
Verify the UI shows 3 bot seats
Verify the multi-deck badge is NOT shown

description: Selecting 10 or more bots in solo mode triggers a multi-deck warning
steps: Navigate to /play/solo
Set bot count to 10
Verify the UI shows a '2 decks in play' badge or warning

description: Each bot seat can be assigned an independent difficulty strategy
steps: Navigate to /play/solo
Add 3 bots
Set bot 1 to 'conservative', bot 2 to 'aggressive', bot 3 to 'optimal'
Start the game
Verify each game_player row reflects the chosen bot_strategy

description: Starting a solo game creates a Game row with mode='solo' and status transitions to in_progress
steps: Navigate to /play/solo
Configure 2 bots
Click 'Start Game'
Verify a Game row is created with mode='solo'
Verify the AASM status is 'in_progress'
Verify current_round equals 1
Verify the page redirects to /game/:id

description: Solo setup layout uses Tailwind mobile-first grid and is thumb-reachable
steps: Resize viewport to 375px width
Navigate to /play/solo
Take a screenshot
Verify bot count and difficulty controls are vertically stacked with ≥44px touch targets
Verify the 'Start Game' button is bottom-anchored

description: Game board loads the current round's initial state from the server
steps: Start a solo game
Verify /game/:id renders the player's hand, opponents' hands, and the Hit/Stay controls
Verify each seat has at least one card face-up from the initial deal

description: Full solo game end-to-end: setup, play multiple rounds, reach 200, declare winner
steps: Sign in as a test user
Navigate to /play/solo
Configure 2 conservative bots
Click 'Start Game'
Verify /game/:id loads and the initial deal has happened
On each of the player's turns, click 'Hit' until the server broadcasts a safe card, then click 'Stay'
Wait for bots to take their turns with 1-2s delays
Verify round_score is calculated and cumulative_scores is updated after each round
Continue playing rounds until a player's cumulative_scores reaches 200+
Verify the round completes fully rather than terminating immediately
Verify the Game row transitions to status='completed' and winner_id is set
Verify a MatchResult row is created per participant with correct placement
Verify the winner's games_won stat is incremented
Verify the results screen shows final standings with cumulative scores

description: Hitting draws exactly one card from the deck and appends it to the player's hand
steps: Start a solo game and wait for your turn
Record the deck length and current hand size
Click 'Hit'
Verify exactly one card was appended to round_state.player_hands[self]
Verify the deck length decremented by exactly one

description: Stay banks the current score and marks the player inactive for the round
steps: Start a solo game and take your turn
Click 'Stay'
Verify round_state.player_statuses[self] equals 'stayed'
Verify round_state.stay_order includes self in the correct position
Verify turn advances to the next active player

description: Drawing a duplicate number card busts the player and zeros their round score
steps: Craft a test game state with a player holding a number card of value 5
Force the next draw to be another 5 via stubbed deck
Call GameEngine.hit on that player
Verify round_state.player_statuses[player] equals 'busted'
Verify round_state.player_scores[player] equals 0
Verify the event broadcast includes a 'bust' type

description: Flip 7 triggers immediate round end and awards a +15 bonus to the achieving player
steps: Craft a test state where a player holds 6 unique number cards
Force the next draw to be a 7th unique number card
Call GameEngine.hit
Verify round_state.player_hands[player].number_cards has 7 unique values
Verify check_round_end returns true
Verify round_score for that player includes the +15 Flip 7 bonus
Verify all other players' turns are skipped and the round advances

description: Scoring order applies ×2 to number_sum before adding +N modifiers and Flip7 bonus
steps: Craft a test hand with number cards summing to 20, a ×2 modifier, and a +4 modifier
Call GameEngine.score_round
Verify number_sum is doubled to 40
Verify round_score equals 40 + 4 = 44
Verify the +4 modifier was NOT doubled

description: Flip 7 bonus is added after modifiers and is not doubled by ×2
steps: Craft a test hand with 7 unique number cards summing to 28, holding a ×2 modifier
Call GameEngine.score_round
Verify number_sum doubles to 56
Verify +15 Flip 7 bonus is added after, for a total of 71
Verify the bonus was NOT doubled

description: Busting zeros the round score regardless of modifiers held
steps: Craft a test hand with number cards summing to 30, a ×2 modifier, and a +10 modifier
Force a bust by drawing a duplicate
Call GameEngine.score_round
Verify round_score equals 0

description: Pyramid deck distribution contains exactly N copies of value N for N in 0..12
steps: Call GameEngine to build a fresh single deck
Count cards of each number value
Verify value 0 has 0 copies, value 1 has 1 copy, up through value 12 having 12 copies
Verify the total number card count equals 79

description: Each deck contains exactly 3 Freeze, 3 Flip Three, 3 Second Chance, and 6 modifier cards
steps: Build a fresh single deck
Count action cards by type and verify 3 each of Freeze, Flip Three, Second Chance
Count modifier cards and verify one each of +2, +4, +6, +8, +10, and ×2
Verify total deck size equals 94

description: Multi-deck scaling uses ceil(player_count / 10) decks
steps: Create games with player counts of 2, 10, 11, 20, 21
Verify deck_count equals 1, 1, 2, 2, 3 respectively
Verify total deck size equals 94 × deck_count for each

description: Multi-deck games still bust on duplicate values from different decks
steps: Build a 2-deck game and deal a player a 5 from deck A
Force the next draw to be a 5 from deck B
Call GameEngine.hit
Verify the player busts

description: Full reshuffle occurs at the start of every round with no cards carried over
steps: Play round 1 in a test game and note which card ids were dealt
Call GameEngine.start_round for round 2
Verify the new deck contains the full 94 cards (single deck) with no cards missing
Verify the previous round's discards and hands are cleared

description: Initial deal resolves action cards immediately before continuing the deal
steps: Stub the deck so the first card dealt is a Freeze targeting self
Call GameEngine.start_round with 3 players
Verify the Freeze resolves immediately before the next player is dealt
Verify the frozen player's status is 'stayed' before the round begins
Verify the remaining players still receive their initial cards

description: Freeze card forces the target to immediately Stay and bank their score
steps: Start a test game with 3 players
Force player 1 to draw a Freeze
Player 1 targets player 2
Verify player 2's status transitions to 'stayed'
Verify player 2's current hand is scored and banked
Verify the turn advances past player 2 in subsequent rounds

description: Freeze can target the drawer themselves
steps: Force a player to draw a Freeze
Choose self as target
Verify the player's status is 'stayed' and their current score is banked

description: Flip Three forces the target to draw exactly three consecutive cards
steps: Start a test game
Force player 1 to draw a Flip Three targeting player 2
Stub the next three deck cards to be non-dup number cards 1, 2, 3
Verify player 2's hand gains cards 1, 2, 3
Verify round_state.pending_flip_three returns to {target_id: nil, remaining: 0} after
Verify control returns to the normal turn order

description: Flip Three can bust the target mid-sequence
steps: Force player 2 to hold a 4
Force player 1 to Flip Three player 2
Stub the next three cards to be 1, 4, 7
Verify player 2 busts after drawing the duplicate 4
Verify the third card is NOT drawn (or is drawn but the bust stands)
Verify player 2's round score is 0

description: Second Chance mid-Flip-Three save allows the sequence to continue
steps: Give player 2 a Second Chance and a number card 4
Force player 1 to Flip Three player 2
Stub the next three cards to be 1, 4, 7
Verify the duplicate 4 is discarded and the Second Chance is consumed
Verify player 2 does not bust and the remaining card 7 is drawn
Verify player 2's hand contains 1, 4 (original), and 7

description: Second Chance is held by the drawer and saves them from a future bust
steps: Force a player to draw a Second Chance
Verify has_second_chance becomes true in their hand state
Force the next draw to be a duplicate number card
Verify the duplicate is discarded and has_second_chance resets to false
Verify the player does not bust

description: Drawing a second Second Chance replaces the first one and the old is discarded, not passed
steps: Give a player a Second Chance
Force them to draw another Second Chance
Verify has_second_chance remains true
Verify only one Second Chance card is referenced in their hand state
Verify the replaced card is discarded and NOT given to another player

description: Flip Three can target the drawer themselves
steps: Force a player to draw a Flip Three
Choose self as target
Verify the three draws apply to the drawer
Verify bust or continuation resolves as normal

description: Round ends when every player has either Stayed or Busted
steps: Start a test game with 3 players
Have all three players either stay or bust
Verify check_round_end returns true
Verify the round advances and scores are banked

description: Game ends when any player reaches 200 cumulative points
steps: Set a player's cumulative_scores to 195
Award them 8 points in a round
Verify check_game_end returns true
Verify the Game transitions to status='completed' with winner_id set

description: When multiple players cross 200 in the same round, highest cumulative wins
steps: Set two players at 190 cumulative
Play a round where player A scores 20 and player B scores 15
Verify winner_id equals player A (210 > 205)
Verify match_results placement reflects this

description: Tiebreak on equal final cumulative scores goes to the player who Stayed earliest
steps: Set two players at 190 cumulative
Play a round where both end with 200 cumulative
Ensure player A entered stay_order before player B
Verify winner_id equals player A

description: Turn timer sets turn_expires_at to 10 seconds in the future on turn start
steps: Start a ranked game
On turn start, verify turn_expires_at equals approximately now + 10 seconds
Verify turn_number incremented by 1

description: Turn timer expiration auto-Stays the current player
steps: Start a ranked game and wait for opponent's turn
Do not act for 11 seconds
Verify TurnTimeoutJob fires and calls GameEngine.timeout_turn
Verify the player's status becomes 'stayed' and their score is banked

description: Stale TurnTimeoutJob executions are guarded by turn_number
steps: Enqueue a TurnTimeoutJob with turn_number=5
Have the player act before the job fires, advancing turn_number to 6
Let the stale job fire
Verify the job no-ops because turn_number no longer matches

description: Auto-stay on timeout for an action card target defaults to opponent (Freeze/Flip Three)
steps: Start a ranked duel
Force the active player to draw a Freeze
Do not act for 11 seconds
Verify timeout auto-targets the opponent with Freeze

description: Bot seats do not use the 10-second turn timer
steps: Start a solo game with one bot
Observe the bot's turn
Verify no TurnTimeoutJob is enqueued for bot turns
Verify the bot acts within 1-2 seconds

description: Bot turns are executed via BotTurnJob with a randomized 1-2 second delay
steps: Trigger a bot turn
Verify BotTurnJob is enqueued with a wait time between 1 and 2 seconds
Verify the bot's action executes through GameEngine.hit or stay

description: Conservative bot strategy stays at 3-4 cards or 20+ points
steps: Instantiate BotBrain with strategy='conservative' and a hand of 4 unique numbers summing to 22
Call decide
Verify the decision is :stay

description: Aggressive bot strategy pushes toward 5-6 cards or higher scores
steps: Instantiate BotBrain with strategy='aggressive' and a hand of 3 unique numbers summing to 15
Call decide
Verify the decision is :hit

description: Optimal bot strategy uses expected value of hitting vs staying
steps: Instantiate BotBrain with strategy='optimal' and a hand where ev_hit > ev_stay
Call decide and verify :hit
Instantiate another BotBrain where ev_stay > ev_hit
Verify :stay

description: Bot action card targeting follows strategy-specific rules
steps: Force a conservative bot to draw a Freeze
Verify it targets the current leader
Force an aggressive bot to draw a Flip Three
Verify it may self-target to chase Flip 7

description: Create a casual game generates a unique 4-character room code
steps: Sign in as a host
Navigate to /play/casual and click 'Create Game'
Verify a Game row is created with mode='casual' and a 4-character room_code
Verify the room_code uses only A-H, J-N, P-Z, 2-9 (no I, O, 0, 1)

description: Room code generation filters against an offensive word blocklist
steps: Mock the random generator to produce a blocked word
Call room code generator
Verify the blocked word is rejected and a different code is issued

description: Room code has unique index scoped to active games only
steps: Create a casual game with a known room_code 'AB23'
Mark it as completed
Create a new casual game
Verify it is allowed to reuse 'AB23' since the first is no longer active

description: Joining a casual game via room code adds the user to game_players
steps: Host creates a casual game with room_code XYZ2
Second user signs in and navigates to /join
Enters XYZ2 and submits
Verify a game_players row is created with correct seat_position
Verify the lobby page loads

description: Direct join link /join/:code pre-fills and joins the room
steps: Create a casual game with room_code ABCD
As another user, visit /join/ABCD directly
Verify the user is added to game_players and redirected to the lobby

description: Casual lobby shows all connected players with Google avatars
steps: Create a casual game with 3 joined users
Open the lobby page
Verify each joined user appears with their name and avatar_url
Verify connection status dots are green

description: Host can add bots to fill seats in a casual lobby
steps: Create a casual game as host
Click 'Add Bot' and select conservative difficulty
Verify a new game_players row with is_bot=true and bot_strategy='conservative'
Verify the lobby shows the bot

description: Only the host can start a casual game
steps: Create a casual game as host
Join as a second user
Verify the non-host user does not see a 'Start Game' button
Verify a direct POST to /games/:id/start by the non-host returns 403

description: Casual game requires at least 2 players to start
steps: Create a casual game as host with no other joined players
Click 'Start Game'
Verify an error flash says 'Minimum 2 players required'
Verify the game status remains 'waiting'

description: Casual games have no upper player limit
steps: Create a casual game and add 15 joined users (mix of real and bots)
Click 'Start Game'
Verify the game starts successfully with 15 seated players
Verify deck_count auto-scales to 2

description: Multi-deck badge appears in the casual lobby when player count exceeds 10
steps: Create a casual game and add 11 players
Open the lobby
Verify a '2 decks in play' badge is visible

description: Empty casual rooms expire after 5 minutes via Sidekiq
steps: Create a casual game at time T
Do not have any additional players join
Fast-forward time by 5 minutes and let RoomExpiryJob fire
Verify the game status transitions to 'expired'

description: Completing a casual game does not affect Elo ratings
steps: Sign in two users with elo_rating=1000
Play a casual game to completion
Verify neither user's elo_rating changed
Verify no MatchResult rows with non-null elo_change for this game

description: Casual game wins still increment lifetime stats and achievements
steps: Win a casual game
Verify games_played and games_won incremented
Verify any eligible achievements are unlocked

description: Ranked mode is locked until the user has played 5 casual games
steps: Sign in as a new user with 0 games
Navigate to /play/ranked
Verify a message indicates ranked unlocks after 5 casual games
Verify no 'Find Match' button is present

description: Ranked unlocks once the 5-casual-game threshold is reached
steps: Seed a user with games_played=5
Navigate to /play/ranked
Verify a 'Find Match' button is rendered

description: Full ranked matchmaking flow pairs two players and transitions to a live duel
steps: Sign in user A with elo_rating=1000 and 5+ casual games
Sign in user B with elo_rating=1020 and 5+ casual games
User A clicks 'Find Match' on /play/ranked
Verify user A is added to the Redis sorted set 'matchmaking:queue'
User B clicks 'Find Match'
Verify MatchmakingWorkerJob pairs them within 5 seconds because ±50 Elo window
Verify a new Game row is created with mode='ranked', max_players=2
Verify both users are notified via MatchmakingChannel with the new game id
Verify both clients redirect to /game/:id
Verify the game status is 'in_progress' and the first round has been dealt
Verify no bots are seated in the ranked game
Verify turn_expires_at is set for the first player

description: Matchmaking window expands from ±50 to ±500 over time
steps: Place user A (Elo 1000) into the queue alone
Advance time by 10 seconds and verify window ±100
Advance by 10 more seconds (20s total) and verify ±200
Advance to 30s and verify ±500
Advance to 60s and verify matching against any available player

description: MatchmakingWorkerJob runs every 5 seconds via Sidekiq cron
steps: Inspect the Sidekiq-cron schedule
Verify MatchmakingWorkerJob is scheduled at a 5-second cadence

description: Leaving the ranked queue removes the user from the Redis sorted set
steps: Enter ranked queue
Click 'Cancel'
Verify DELETE /matchmaking/queue is issued
Verify the user is removed from matchmaking:queue in Redis

description: Ranked games use a 2-player format with no bots
steps: Create a ranked game via matchmaking
Verify max_players equals 2
Verify no game_players row has is_bot=true

description: Elo update applied after ranked game completion with K=48 for provisional players
steps: Sign in user A with elo_rating=1000 and games_played=5 (provisional)
Play a ranked duel to completion where user A wins
Verify new_rating = 1000 + 48 * (1 - 0.5) = 1024
Verify user A's elo_rating is now 1024

description: Elo update uses K=32 for non-provisional players (20+ games)
steps: Sign in user A with games_played=25
Win a ranked duel against an equal-Elo opponent
Verify K=32 is used and new Elo equals 1016

description: Elo floor of 100 cannot be breached on loss
steps: Set a user's elo_rating to 110
Have them lose a ranked match to a 1500 opponent
Verify the computed new rating would drop below 100
Verify the stored rating clamps to exactly 100

description: Ranked disconnect with 30-second grace period allows resume
steps: Start a ranked duel
Force user A to disconnect the WebSocket
Verify PlayerDisconnectJob is enqueued with a 30-second delay
Reconnect user A within 30 seconds
Verify PlayerDisconnectJob is cancelled or no-ops
Verify game state_sync is broadcast to the reconnected client

description: Ranked disconnect beyond 30 seconds forfeits the game and awards Elo loss
steps: Start a ranked duel between user A and user B
Disconnect user A and wait 31 seconds
Verify PlayerDisconnectJob fires and marks the game as completed with winner_id=user B
Verify user A's elo_rating decreased and user B's increased
Verify user A's ranked_losses and user B's ranked_wins incremented

description: Three or more ranked disconnects in 24 hours trigger a 15-minute matchmaking cooldown
steps: Record 3 disconnect events for a user within 24 hours
Attempt to enter the ranked queue
Verify the request is rejected with a 'cooldown' message
Advance time 15 minutes and verify queue entry is allowed

description: Action Cable GameChannel streams state updates for the game id
steps: Subscribe to GameChannel with params[:game_id]
Make a move via POST /games/:id/moves/hit
Verify a turbo_stream broadcast is received for the drawn card
Verify the hand partial is replaced in the DOM

description: GameChannel resubscribe sends a full state_sync HTML payload
steps: Subscribe to GameChannel for an in-progress game
Disconnect and reconnect the channel
Verify a state_sync message with a full rendered game HTML payload is received
Verify the DOM reflects current round_state

description: LobbyChannel broadcasts player-joined and player-left presence updates
steps: Subscribe to LobbyChannel for a waiting game
Have another user join the game
Verify a turbo_stream append with the new player partial is received
Have them leave and verify a remove broadcast

description: MatchmakingChannel is personal per user and delivers match_found notifications
steps: Subscribe to MatchmakingChannel as user A
Have user B also subscribe
Trigger a match between them
Verify user A and user B each receive a 'match_found' message with the game id on their own stream

description: Optimistic locking raises StaleObjectError on concurrent game mutations and retries once
steps: Load the same game in two contexts at lock_version=5
Save context A to advance to lock_version=6
Attempt to save context B
Verify StaleObjectError is raised
Verify the retry path reloads the game and reapplies the action

description: Advisory lock serializes concurrent actions on the same game
steps: Attempt to hit and timeout the same game id simultaneously from two processes
Verify Game.with_advisory_lock('game_:id') blocks the second until the first completes
Verify final state is consistent

description: Server enforces that only the player whose turn it is can act
steps: Start a game where it is player A's turn
Have player B POST /games/:id/moves/hit
Verify the request is rejected with a 403 or validation error
Verify no state change occurred

description: Rematch creates a new game with the same players and settings linked via rematch_of
steps: Complete a casual game with players [A, B, C]
Click 'Rematch' from the results screen
Verify POST /games/:id/rematch creates a new Game row
Verify the new game has mode='casual', same players, and rematch_of equal to the prior game id
Verify both players are redirected to the new lobby/game

description: flip7_first achievement unlocks when a player achieves their first Flip 7
steps: Sign in a fresh user
Play a game and have the user achieve a Flip 7
Verify a UserAchievement row exists with achievement_key='flip7_first' and unlocked_at set
Verify a toast notification was broadcast via Action Cable

description: Flip 7 tiered achievements progress through flip7_5, flip7_10, flip7_25, flip7_50, flip7_100
steps: Seed a user with 4 Flip 7s
Achieve a 5th Flip 7
Verify flip7_5 unlocks
Seed user with 9 and achieve 10th, verify flip7_10
Seed user with 24 and achieve 25th, verify flip7_25
Repeat for 50 and 100
Verify each tier's parent_key chains correctly

description: calculated_risk achievement unlocks when a player wins with exactly 200 cumulative points
steps: Set a player's cumulative score so the winning round lands exactly at 200
Complete the game
Verify calculated_risk achievement is unlocked

description: high_roller_50, _75, and _100 achievements trigger on single-round scores
steps: Score exactly 50 in a round and verify high_roller_50 unlocks
Score 75 and verify high_roller_75
Score 100 and verify high_roller_100

description: zero_hero achievement unlocks when a player wins a round with a 0 card in hand
steps: Craft a game state with a 0 card in the player's hand
Have the player win that round
Verify zero_hero is unlocked

description: extra_life achievement unlocks on a Flip 7 with an unused Second Chance
steps: Have a player hold a Second Chance while achieving Flip 7
Verify extra_life unlocks

description: ice_cold achievement: Freeze a player within 10 of winning, then win
steps: Set opponent's cumulative to 192
Player draws a Freeze and targets the opponent
Player then wins the game
Verify ice_cold unlocks

description: david_vs_goliath achievement: win a game despite being 50+ behind
steps: Seed state with player at 100, opponent at 160
Have player rally and win the game
Verify david_vs_goliath unlocks

description: speed_run achievement: win a game in 5 or fewer rounds
steps: Engineer a solo game that reaches 200 within 5 rounds
Verify speed_run unlocks on game completion

description: action_taker achievement: draw all 3 action card types in one round
steps: Force a player to draw Freeze, Flip Three, and Second Chance in a single round
Verify action_taker unlocks at round end

description: second_chance_saver achievement: use a Second Chance to avoid a bust
steps: Give player a Second Chance
Force a bust scenario
Verify Second Chance consumes, player avoids bust
Verify second_chance_saver unlocks

description: threes_company achievement: survive all three cards from a Flip Three
steps: Force a Flip Three on a player
Stub three safe non-duplicate cards
Verify the player survives and threes_company unlocks

description: sweep achievement: win 3 consecutive rounds
steps: Play a game where the same player wins rounds 1, 2, and 3
Verify sweep unlocks after round 3 scoring

description: the_repeater anti-achievement: bust by drawing a duplicate number
steps: Force a player to bust by drawing a duplicate
Verify the_repeater unlocks

description: zero_points anti-achievement: bust in the very first round of a game
steps: Start a fresh game
Force a player to bust in round 1
Verify zero_points unlocks

description: zero_trust anti: draw a 0 and immediately bust on the next card
steps: Force a player to draw a 0
Force the next draw to cause a bust
Verify zero_trust unlocks

description: second_life_lost anti: draw a Second Chance and bust on the very next card
steps: Force a player to draw a Second Chance
Force the next draw to be an un-savable scenario (after consumption, a second bust)
Verify second_life_lost unlocks

description: glutton anti: bust while holding 50+ points in your hand
steps: Craft a hand summing to 55
Force a bust
Verify glutton unlocks

description: flip_three_flop anti: bust during a forced Flip Three draw
steps: Force a Flip Three on a player who will bust mid-sequence
Verify flip_three_flop unlocks

description: risky_business anti: draw 5+ cards successfully then bust
steps: Build a hand with 5 unique number cards
Force a bust on the 6th draw
Verify risky_business unlocks

description: modifier_misstep anti: bust while holding the ×2 multiplier
steps: Give a player a ×2 modifier
Force a bust
Verify modifier_misstep unlocks

description: freeze_dried anti: get Frozen while within 10 points of winning
steps: Set a player's cumulative to 192
Force an opponent to Freeze them
Verify freeze_dried unlocks

description: so_close anti: bust while holding 190+ cumulative points
steps: Seed cumulative at 195
Force a bust that round
Verify so_close unlocks

description: flip_flop anti: get 6 unique number cards then bust on the 7th draw
steps: Build hand with 6 unique number cards
Force the 7th draw to be a duplicate
Verify flip_flop unlocks

description: all_in_all_out anti: bust with 80+ points worth of cards in hand
steps: Craft a hand with number cards summing to 85
Force a bust
Verify all_in_all_out unlocks

description: Achievements are evaluated at round end for round-specific achievements
steps: Play a round that triggers high_roller_50
Verify evaluation runs at round end, not game end
Verify the UserAchievement is created before the next round starts

description: Achievements are evaluated at game end for game-specific achievements
steps: Complete a game triggering speed_run
